purpose: Summative artifact applying A10.1 and A10.2 across length, mass, and capacity. Used as Lesson 5 capstone evidence.
student_learning_goal: I can compare and measure things in different ways.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can compare and measure things in different ways.
header.character_watermark: Max and Tess together in the top-right corner with carnival hats. Small (~1.5in tall combined). References both characters from blueprint.recurring_characters.

parts.student_instructions: Number the strips 1 (shortest) to 4 (longest). Then measure your favourite with cubes — write how many cubes long.
parts.visual_layout: Four horizontal strips of varied lengths stacked vertically, all aligned at the left edge. Lengths: 1in, 4in, 2in, 3in (mixed). Beside each strip, a number box. Below the strips, a single response line: 'My favourite is ___ cubes long.'

image_placeholders.description: Four horizontal strips for a Kindergarten capstone worksheet, B&W line art. Lengths in mixed order from top to bottom: 2in, 4in, 1in, 3in. Each strip ~0.4in tall, thin solid border, aligned at the left edge. Beside each strip, an empty number box (~0.5in × 0.5in) for ordering 1-4. Below the strips, a single sentence-frame line for recording cube measurement.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS05_P1_STRIPS at Part 1: instructions ask the child to order strips and measure with cubes. Keywords name the visual elements (strips), the unit (cubes), and the comparison endpoint (longest).

parts.answer_key: Top to bottom: 2in→2, 4in→4, 1in→1, 3in→3. Cube count varies based on which strip the child picks (1in≈3 cubes, 2in≈6 cubes, 3in≈9 cubes, 4in≈12 cubes if cubes are 1cm).

parts.student_instructions: Look at each balance. Write H by the heavier side and L by the lighter side. If the balance is level, write S (same).
parts.visual_layout: Three balance pictures stacked vertically. Each balance has two pans with a different object pair: (1) brick + feather (brick lower), (2) book + pencil (book lower), (3) two same blocks (level). Each balance ~3in × 2in. Beside each pan, a label box.

image_placeholders.description: Three balance pictures in B&W line art for a Kindergarten capstone worksheet. Each balance has a triangular fulcrum and two horizontal pans. Balance 1: brick on left (lower) + feather on right (higher). Balance 2: book on left (lower) + pencil on right (higher). Balance 3: two same blocks on each side, balance level (both pans equal height). Each ~3in × 2in. Beside each pan, a small empty box for writing H, L, or S.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS05_P2_BALANCES at Part 2: instructions ask the child to label balances with H/L/S. Keywords name the visual artifact (balance) and the response options (heavier, lighter).

parts.answer_key: Balance 1: brick=H, feather=L. Balance 2: book=H, pencil=L. Balance 3: both blocks=S (same).

parts.student_instructions: Circle the cup that holds MORE in each pair. Then find a SAME-capacity pair and circle BOTH cups.
parts.visual_layout: Three cup pairs stacked vertically. Pair 1: large mug + small espresso cup. Pair 2: bowl + glass. Pair 3: two identical cups. Each pair ~3in × 1.5in. Below the pairs, a small label: 'Pair 3 = SAME capacity'.

image_placeholders.description: Three cup pairs in B&W line art for a Kindergarten capstone worksheet. Pair 1: large coffee mug + tiny espresso cup. Pair 2: cereal bowl + small drinking glass. Pair 3: two identical drinking cups. Each pair ~3in × 1.5in. Below the pairs, a small label box noting pair 3 is SAME capacity.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS05_P3_CUPS at Part 3: instructions ask the child to circle holds-more cups and identify a same-capacity pair. Keywords name the visual elements (cups) and comparison criteria (more, same).

parts.answer_key: Pair 1: large mug. Pair 2: bowl. Pair 3: BOTH cups circled (same capacity).

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, draw your favourite carnival station. Tell your partner why.
teacher_notes: Lesson 5 capstone — summative evidence for the unit. Score against the capstone rubric. Part 1 captures A10.1 (cubes) + A10.2 (length comparison). Part 2 captures A10.2 (mass). Part 3 captures A10.2 (capacity, including 'same' recognition). Children who score full marks across all 3 parts demonstrate full unit mastery.
